title: Hinomori Shizuku — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew... Now that I've made it this far, I should be close.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah! Look at you, you're doing great♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That construction was definitely a surprise... But it sure was lucky that you ran into your friends, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It was. I'll need to thank them both properly once this is all done with.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Alright then, let's get to our destination!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Thanks for talking to us, Shizuku!
Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course. You be careful, now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe. It was so nice of them to come say hello to me.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Let's see, I just crossed the street with them, so next should be... A right turn here!)

Heeeeey!
Sh-Shizuku...!
se_run_women_001_1
se_run_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh? Saki, Honami... Were you both running just now?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, uhh... Yeah!
Me and Hona were having a race! Right, Hona?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, we were.
Um, Shizuku, were you...on your way somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. You see, Shii sent me on an errand, so I was just on my way to the dry cleaners.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Dry cleaners...
Shizuku, um... I think that's in the opposite direction.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You should reach the dry cleaners if you keep following this road.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Asahina, you've been a great help.
I could have sworn I was nearly there, but I just couldn't seem to find my way...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No need to thank me. After all, I just happened to run into you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And it was nice getting to have a leisurely chat with you. We haven't had the chance lately.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe... I'm happy we got to chat as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know. Would you like to spend our school lunch break together one of these days? I'd like another one of these leisurely chats.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's a good idea. I'd be happy to do that the next time you're available. Just let me know.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay! I'll send you a message then.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I made it...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is the place Shii told me about, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah! The name's right, and I see Lapin just over there!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You really hung in there, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm so glad...!
Thank you both so much for supporting me along the way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I never would have made it if I were on my own... I'll need to thank everyone I ran into today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, Shii is waiting... First, I'll pick up her dry cleaning!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Right! Good luck♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I've got the dry cleaning, so now all that's left is to buy her cake at the cafe before heading home.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe... I hope Shii will be pleased.
Cafe

Good job, Shizuku!
Good job, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're all here? But why...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe, that's just the reaction we wanted to see!
Alright, time to let the cat out of the bag!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! So...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku, you just walked into your birthday party!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My birthday party...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hinomori sent you on some errands, right?
The truth is, that was all part of the plan to get you here for our surprise.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We factored in the amount of time it would take us to get things set up here, too.
Look, we did figure you'd get a little bit lost along the way, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You exceeded our expectations, to the point that we were all on the edge of our seats here...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But hey, that let us really nail down all the prep, and we're just glad you made it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wow, so you planned this all out for me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright... Now that you know what's going on, I guess it's time everyone else came out to say hello.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. Come on out, everybody!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?
Phew, I'm so glad the surprise worked out!
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh my, this many people...?!
Even everyone I ran into on my way over...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We weren't kidding ourselves that you'd manage to get here on your own. So, we had a few people stationed as secret guides.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So that's what was going on... You were all there just for me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, it was fun 'cause it kinda felt like we were detectives!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You were acting super suspicious though, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway... You did it, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I was able to press on because I really wanted to do what you asked of me and make your day.
But now I've been given such a lovely surprise...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You brightened my day, not the other way around.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm so happy right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey now, the party hasn't even started yet. The real fun is still to come!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. Now that the girl of the hour is here, let's get the ball rolling.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All of us here on the setup team did the decor.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We made that table all pretty with lots of origami☆
And the shiny sparkly wonderhoy royal seat is just for you, Hinomori! Right this way♪

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
The food's gonna amaze too!
We've got lots, so eat your fill!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We have cake from this cafe and some Japanese sweets we brought for dessert, so we hope you'll be more than satisfied!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you... Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, since you've all been so kind... Let's enjoy this party together!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Shizuku!
We swooped in just in the nick of time out there, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Even waiting around was fun, since it felt like a stakeout from one of those crime shows...
It was all for your birthday, but we ended up being entertained too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, I was more worried than entertained... Still, I could tell how happy you were, Shizuku. I'm glad the surprise went so well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe, so many people were there to celebrate. I'm glad I got to give you my birthday wishes in person too.
Enjoy your special day, and let's talk again at school.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hinomori.
Our team picked out a gift for you based on the things Ena says you like, so you should be getting it from Kohane and An.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
We decided on a long-tailed bushtit mug.
It's cold out this time of year, so we hope you'll use it to drink something warm and relax.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It hit us the moment we found it. We just knew it was perfect for you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Have a great birthday, Shizuku!
I'm super happy we got to celebrate with that surprise!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I took lots of photos at the party, so I hope you'll look forward to seeing them!
Let me say it again, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Hinomori.
I don't believe Emu mentioned, but the throne you sat on during the party was a prop we use in shows. She asked to borrow one, you see.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe, I told him to pick the cushiest one of all☆
Your smiling face told me it was super comfy, and that made me smile too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, it's a seat truly befitting of a star!
As for the surprise, Saki was quite excited about it, so I was relieved to hear that it went swimmingly.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'm sure you're quite busy, but it would be nice to take another siblings trip sometime.
Have a fantastic birthday, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: All together now! One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Ichika & Honami
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Shizuku!
Happy birthday, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was glad to see you so happy with the food and the decor and everything.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, your eyes were totally sparkling, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh yeah! Shiho couldn't stop worrying about you the day of the surprise, you know?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, she kept sending messages to everyone to keep track of how you were progressing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I mean, it'd be harder not to be concerned.
She's always getting lost...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Um... I said it at the party, but I should say it again. Happy birthday, Shizuku.
I know you're busy with work and stuff, but... Make sure you're giving yourself time to breathe, okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Shizuku!
You looked so happy to be getting all those birthday wishes at the party, and that made me happy too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We got a bit antsy since you kept getting lost... It was such a relief that you made it without any major trouble.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Once again, Shizuku, happy birthday.
Let's keep doing our best together to support everyone cheering us on.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I was glad to see our surprise go so well!
Y'know, everybody was more than happy to lend a hand when they heard we were doing something for your birthday. You sure have a magnetism to you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Let's keep delivering more hope together!
I hope you have a great birthday, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for the birthday wishes, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: To have this many people celebrate my birthday... I'm so truly fortunate.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My family, my friends, my fans... I feel even more deeply that all of you are here supporting me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But of course, me receiving your support can't be the end. I need to give back to every one of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I think that feeling is best conveyed through my work with MORE MORE JUMP!, by shining as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So I'll continue pushing forward with all my strength.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm far from perfect... But I hope you'll all keep watching me.
